Unwind with a Creative Reset: a blend of yoga, meditation, and drawing designed to help you relax, reconnect, and create without pressure.

About this Event

Intentional & Elevated: A Meditative Drawing Experience
Join us at Fulton Street Collective on October 19th at 6:30 PM for a 90-minute creative reset designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and create.
This guided experience weaves together gentle yoga, meditation, and intuitive drawing, inviting you to quiet the mind and tap into your natural creativity. No pressure, no perfection, just space to explore and unwind.
Whether you’re new to yoga or drawing (or both), this class is for you.
✨ Leave feeling grounded, clear, and creatively recharged
🎨 Bring your favorite drawing tools or use ours
🧘‍♀️ BYOYM (bring your own yoga mat; a limited number available)
Spots are limited to keep the experience intimate.
